title: Make the lead skill name a review command that works
body:
Outcome: krn-lead step 7 names a review invocation that runs as written. Observed 2026-11-01: `krn review --repo <path>` on PATH exits 64 "unknown option: --repo" (installed krn lacks review); repository bin/krn has it but exits 64 "--repo must be an absolute path" for a relative path. Fix: install/forward review in the installed krn or make the skill name bin/krn with absolute paths; accept relative --repo by resolving it.
Proof: a test that runs the skill-named command shape against the CLI receiver and gets past argument parsing.
Lead trap: krn-lead names `bin/krn review` with an absolute --repo until this ships.
